name: Aura of False Divinity
description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the creature must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, provided the creature isn’t incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by the creature. A creature charmed in this way can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once it succeeds on the saving throw, a creature is immune to this radiant idol’s Aura of False Divinity for 24 hours.
